create_fifo_selector: create a FIFO item selector that samples items in first-in-first-out order from a reverb table
create_lifo_selector: create a LIFO item selector that samples items in last-in-first-out order from a reverb table
create_max_heap_selector: create a max-heap item selector that prioritizes items with the highest priority values
create_min_heap_selector: create a min-heap item selector that prioritizes items with the lowest priority values
create_prioritized_selector: create a prioritized item selector that samples items based on their assigned priority weights
